{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Fine-knit pullover, slim fit with a softly scooped neckline, hip length, slate blue #5b6e82, extra-fine merino wool

A-line pleated midi skirt, falling just below the knee, with a smooth waistband, charcoal #2f2b2f, soft wool crepe

Textured cropped jacket (outer layer), straight cut with a slightly shaped waist, hip length, deep navy #2a3345 with fine charcoal flecks, wool bouclé tweed

Ankle boots, almond toe, low block heel, ankle height, black #1c1a1c, smooth leather

Sheer tights, matte, black #1c1a1c, fine knit

Small structured shoulder bag, top handle with a chain strap, burgundy #6d2e3c, grained leather

Drop earrings, small, freshwater pearl with a thin silver setting, soft ivory #f1ebe0, pearl and silver

Why this outfit works: The slate blue knit repeats the color of her eyes, and next to her light skin and dark hair it looks calm and clear under theatre lighting. The pleated midi skirt and the textured jacket give a neat, polished social look without being too formal for an evening performance. The jacket adds warmth for a cool autumn night, and the low block-heel boots stay comfortable through the whole play and the interval. The burgundy bag and pearl earrings add a quiet touch of richness to the cool, deep palette."}
